title: Computational Materials Modeling Software — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Computational Materials Modeling Software — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Predicts material behavior from composition and microstructure with physics models.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Computational Materials Modeling Software, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (CALPHAD phase-equilibrium and property calculations). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: CALPHAD phase-equilibrium and property calculations and Phase-field microstructure evolution. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Density functional theory (DFT) calculation package) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
